trust_decision.summary: Input-derived names (map keys, field names, enum value names, option names) must be stored as own properties and must never resolve through Object.prototype; the fix enforces this at parse/schema-load time in the text-format parser, the descriptor loader, the proto-source parser, the reflection option API, and the code generators.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names text-format string-map parsing; parseMapField is the only place that seeds a map object for a text-format map field, and at the pinned commit it seeds it from a prototype-chain lookup (object[field.name]) and writes entries with a bare index assignment.

fix_sites.entry_point: pbjs CLI, static target (buildEnum emits the enum value map)
util.merge, used by Type.fromObject / Type.toObject converters

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The static target only emits text; a solver can argue the advisory is about the runtime text-format parser and that generated-code hardening is a separate build-time concern, especially since the same file's output is regenerated by tests/data fixtures.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Field names, map keys and enum value names that shadow Object.prototype members (toString, hasOwnProperty, constructor) are legitimate data and must keep working; util.isUnsafeProperty also rejects constructor and prototype, so an over-broad fix that reuses it for name lookups silently drops legitimate fields, enum values and options.

O6_input_shapes: map field as one braced entry: labels { key: "a" value: ... }
map field as a bracketed list of entries: labels: [{ key: ... }, { key: ... }]
map key that is a prototype member string: key: "__proto__"
field name that camelCases onto a prototype member: to_string -> toString, has_own_property -> hasOwnProperty
repeated field in both singular and bracketed-list forms
enum value given by a shadowing name (constructor) versus by number
enum value and option names coming from a descriptor object or from Enum.fromJSON values object (__proto__, toString)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Type.fromObject / Message.fromObject reads the source value with if(d[field.name]!=null), so a field named toString resolves to Object.prototype.toString instead of being treated as absent; the mirrored toObject path in the same generator does use Object.hasOwnProperty.call.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: fromObject is the reflection converter for already-shaped source objects, not the text-format parser the report names, and its map branch already guards __proto__ keys.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ReflectionObject#setParsedOption routes option members through util.setProperty, whose prevValue = dst[part] read walks the prototype chain, so an option member named toString becomes [Object.prototype.toString, value] before it is stored.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: setProperty already rejects __proto__/prototype/constructor through util.isUnsafeProperty, so it looks like the already-safe primitive and is left untouched although the same prevValue pattern was fixed in src/parse.js:822 and src/util/minimal.js:285.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second structured-input map reader modelled on the JSON map branch that builds the map with Object.create(null) and rejects duplicate keys
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: protojson already ships the hardened version of exactly this map-building operation, so a maintainer adding another text/JSON input route would plausibly copy this block.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third read path (e.g. a fromText-to-plain-object helper) that seeds the result with a plain {} and reuses the direct index-assignment idiom
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the module already keeps two parallel read paths over the same field tables (writeMessage at 868 and verifyTextMessage at 1179), so another route into the same object-building code is natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an ES-module code generation target that emits its own enum value-map initializer next to cli/targets/static.js:1106
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pbjs has seven code-generation targets (proto, proto2, proto3, static, static-module, json, json-module) that each re-implement emitted runtime helpers, so a maintainer could easily add the same fix to only one of them.

O9_family: prototype pollution / improper control of object prototype attributes (CWE-1321)
